job.title: IT Support Engineer I, Ops Tech Solutions Delivery - Fixed, IT Support
job.pay_full: $30.24 – $41.68 an hour base pay (Nampa, ID), plus sign-on payments and restricted stock units

details.about: Operations Technology Solutions gives Amazon Operations round-the-clock global IT support. As an IT Support Engineer I you put technical solutions in place and support computer hardware, operating systems and enterprise software across several sites in one area, solving problems even where no standard procedure exists.
duties: Network engineering and troubleshooting, data cabling and systems administration across varied software and hardware
Keep networking and computing systems available during production hours
Give management and staff analytical and technical help to keep improving IT solutions
Run local technical projects and maintain or create policies, procedures and processes
Find root causes of operational issues and process inefficiencies
Support customers in several buildings in the area, plus remote customers, travelling locally or regionally (reliable transportation required)
Move up to 49 lbs and stand and walk during shifts of up to 12 hours
needs: 1+ years of Windows Server technologies: AD, DFS, Print Services, SCCM
2+ years troubleshooting in a multi-user, high-availability environment
2+ years of PC repair, troubleshooting, deployment and liquidation
1+ years of IT client, server and network service delivery
2+ years of networking (DNS, DHCP, SSL, OSI model, TCP/IP)
2+ years supporting Windows, Mac or Linux operating systems in a corporate setting
2+ years supporting and maintaining a corporate network
nice: CompTIA A+, CompTIA Network+, Cisco/CCNA, Linux (Red Hat), Microsoft hardware installation, AWS or other relevant certifications
details.benefits: Base pay $30.24 – $41.68 an hour (Nampa, ID). The package includes sign-on payments and restricted stock units (RSUs); final pay depends on experience, qualifications and location. Benefits include healthcare from day one (medical, dental, vision, prescription), life and AD&D insurance, mental health support, flexible spending accounts, adoption and surrogacy reimbursement, 401(k) matching, paid time off and up to 20 weeks of paid parental leave.
notes: Shifts of up to 12 hours; lifting up to 49 lbs
Local or regional travel to support customers; reliable transportation required
Amazon offers workplace accommodations during the hiring process for candidates with disabilities
